data.name: South End After Hours
data.headline: An Evening Off-the-Beaten-Path Boston Food & Cocktail Experience
data.description:
# *Local Foods, Libations & Lots of Fun!*

*Available exclusively on Friday evenings, visit the local eateries South End residents call home. Walk to 4 different locations, where each visit includes an alcoholic beverage paired with your food tasting.*
data.cancellation_notes:
**For Non-Refundable Tickets:** All sales are final - no refunds or exchanges.

**For Refundable Tickets:** At least 48 hours notice is required in order to receive a refund. Tickets canceled less than 48 hours prior to the tour start time will not be refunded or rescheduled. Late arrivals and / or No-shows will also not be refunded or rescheduled. Thank you for your cooperation.

*PLEASE CHECK YOUR EVENT DATE CAREFULLY BEFORE BOOKING.*

This experience was created as an adult activity. **We kindly ask that all guests joining our tour be at least 12 years of age.** This activity is not appropriate to attend with infants or toddlers, and strollers are not permitted on any of our tours.

Due to agreements in place with our partner restaurants, there is a maximum guest capacity per tour. **EVERY participant must have a ticket to join the tour.**
data.booking_notes:
___________________________________
## Important Details 

* **Please plan to arrive 5-10 minutes early, as our tours start right on time**.

* Gratuity for your tour guide is *not included in your ticket price*. While not mandatory, if you enjoy yourself and would like to consider a tip for your tour guide, **gratuities are greatly appreciated and graciously accepted at the end of the tour.**

* Taking photos is welcomed encouraged!

___________________________________
## What to Bring

* If you are consuming alcohol, please bring your **driver's license or passport**.
* This tour takes place rain or shine and New England weather can be unpredictable, so **please check the weather and temperature on the day of your tour and dress for the forecast**. We have fun in all types of weather, and being prepared for the elements will go a long way in making the most of your tour experience!
* **Please wear comfortable clothes and walking shoes. We will be outdoors and on our feet for most of the tour**, and we want you to be as comfortable as possible.


___________________________________
## Parking

Meters in the South End have a 2-hour limit per block, which is not enough time to cover the full length of the tour. We recommend arriving via public transportation when possible, or parking in a lot. We have included 2 South End Parking lot options for your convenience - please see below.

* **Atelier 505 Parking Garage**: Enter at 15 Warren Ave, Boston, MA 02116
$28 for 3-10 hours - Max $38/ day (Rates as of May 2024)
Phone: (617) 262-8426

* **GTI Properties Lot #2**: 324 Albany Street, Boston, MA 02118
*This lot is located under Interstate 93, entrance and exit on Albany Street.*
$2.50/hr - Credit Card Only (Rates as of May 2024)

___________________________________
## FAQs

**Are there vegetarian options available?**
We can provide vegetarian options in most tasting locations with advance notice. Please be sure to make this request when purchasing tickets as we will not be able to arrange for alternative options on the day of the tour.

We are not able to accommodate a vegan diet on any of our tours.

**How much food can I expect to eat during the tour?**
We provide tastings, so please do not expect a full meal at each location. Tastings vary in portion size, with some tastings served while seated inside the restaurant, and others served in a more “on the go” manner to also allow time for the neighborhood component of the tour.

**This sounds fun but what if I - or someone in my party - does not drink alcohol??**
No problem!  We can provide alternative, non-alcoholic beverages with advance notice. Please select this option during checkout. Also, please know local food is our focus, so the beverages are a simply meant to complement the main start of the show.

**Can children participate in the tour? What about toddlers and strollers?**
Our Happy Hour Tours are 21+. This activity is not appropriate to attend with infants and, due to space limitations, strollers are not permitted on any of our tours. Thank you for your cooperation.

**Is parking available near the starting location of the tour?**
Parking is available but limited near the meeting location. Additionally, city parking meters have a 2-hour maximum limit, which is not sufficient to cover the duration of the tour. We find using the T or arriving in a cab is easiest, but ***parking garage options will be provided in a confirmation email following ticket purchase***. We do recommend using one of the suggested parking garages to avoid any confusion with Boston parking rules and regulations.

**Are restrooms available during the tour?**
Restrooms will be available throughout the tour at most tasting locations.

___________________________________
